audience: sales teams that run cold email campaigns in Woodpecker

useCases.title: Check which campaigns are running
useCases.text: List campaigns by status, such as RUNNING or PAUSED. Get one campaign for its sent, opened, replied and bounced counts.

useCases.title: Read replies in the unified inbox
useCases.text: List replies filtered by campaign, mailbox, prospect status, interest or read state. Get the replies of one prospect.

useCases.title: Find a prospect and its campaigns
useCases.text: Search prospects by email address or company, with the campaigns each one belongs to. List the prospects enrolled in one or more campaigns.

useCases.title: Build a statistics report for up to 30 days
useCases.text: Request a per-campaign report for a date range of up to 30 days. Fetch the report by its hash once its status is READY.

useCases.title: Check mailbox limits and blacklists
useCases.text: List the sending mailboxes with their daily limits and sent-today counts. Check whether a domain or email address is blacklisted.

useCases.title: Pause a campaign or add prospects to it
useCases.text: Pause a running campaign, so no more emails go out until it runs again. Add 1 to 500 prospects to a campaign.
